headline: Chris Brown brought a fan on stage during his performance — and the whole arena locked in
body: Chris Brown brought a fan on stage during his performance — and the whole arena locked in instantly. The moment turned into pure chaos and excitement as the fan completely froze, then burst into energy once CB hyped them up Fans say Chris always knows how to make someone’s night unforgettable. chrisbrown.
